purpose: Teach: 年度末/社債/付け加える/構える/済ませる/終日/折っ/心がける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、年度末は、経営者にとって、節目だ。
lines.en: Ren — year-end is a milestone for any executive.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried. Slight weight on 「節目」—a threshold, not just a date. Speaking from experience. Not warm, but attentive. The tone of someone whose silence carries as much as his words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。社債について、勉強しました。
lines.en: Yes. I studied corporate bonds thoroughly.
lines.style: Quiet, respectful nod in the voice. Alert but not overwrought. A small uptick on 「勉強しました」—showing he took it seriously. Hands slightly forward, ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 発表に、自分の見解を付け加える勇気、持て。
lines.en: Have the courage to add your own perspective to the presentation.
lines.style: Not a command—a permission. Quiet conviction. Leans forward slightly on 「勇気」. The kind of boss who names what you're afraid of so you stop being afraid of it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。長期視点で構えるつもりです、キャリアを。
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to approach my career with a longer view.
lines.style: Quick, steady. Forward-facing. He's heard the directive and is already thinking ahead. Respectful but not servile—building something, not just following orders.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: インターン業務、今週、済ませるように。
lines.en: Get the intern work finished this week.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. No edge, but no softening either. The expectation is clear. Delivered while doing something else—shifting papers, checking the time. Efficient.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。終日、学ばせていただきます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to complete it all today while learning as much as I can.
lines.style: Quick agreement, then a small exhale of determination. Not anxious—focused. The 「していただきます」carries weight: I'm grateful for this chance and I won't waste it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書、ここを折って、サイン欄を出せ。
lines.en: Contract here — fold at this line so the signature field is visible.
lines.style: Practical, instructional. Slight tap of the finger on the fold line. Not teaching a lesson, just telling him where to fold. Brief, actionable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。礼儀、心がけるよう、徹底します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll be thorough about the details and conduct myself with care.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Calm, collected finish. He's understood what matters—not just the task, but the integrity underneath it. Small, satisfied nod at the end of the line.
